Job Description 
A Boston education organization is seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to support a major application modernization initiative. This organization manages technology platforms that support education services and is investing in the transformation of critical systems to improve scalability, security, reliability, and user experience. 
The selected engineer will play a key role in modernizing legacy Java/Spring and .NET applications by rebuilding them using modern technologies including Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, and React. This is a highly technical, hands-on position that involves analyzing existing systems, uncovering business logic within legacy applications, and developing scalable, cloud-based solutions. This contract opportunity runs through June 2027 and offers a flexible hybrid work arrangement. 
Required Skills & Experience
   Senior-level experience in full stack software engineering  Experience developing and supporting Java/Spring and .NET applications  Strong expertise with Node.js and TypeScript  Experience building modern applications with Angular and React  Experience working with legacy system modernization initiatives  Experience designing and developing scalable APIs  Knowledge of cloud-native application development and architecture  
 
Desired Skills & Experience    Experience participating in enterprise application modernization projects  Ability to analyze legacy systems and translate business logic into modern solutions  Experience building secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-based applications  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills  
What You Will Be Doing 
Daily Responsibilities    100% Hands On  Analyze existing Java/Spring and .NET applications to understand technical architecture and business requirements  Migrate and rebuild legacy applications using Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, and React  Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs and modern web applications  Build cloud-native solutions that improve scalability, security, and system reliability  Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions  Identify and document business logic embedded within legacy systems  Implement modern software engineering best practices and architectural patterns  Contribute to a large-scale modernization effort involving multiple enterprise applications
